employees_by_gang.sql: SELECT "HR_EMPLOYEE"."EmpCode", "HR_EMPLOYEE"."EmpName", "HR_EMPLOYEE"."Gender", "HR_EMPLOYEE"."LocCode", "HR_GANGLN"."GangCode" FROM "HR_EMPLOYEE" JOIN "HR_GANGLN" ON "HR_GANGLN"."GangMember" = "HR_EMPLOYEE"."EmpCode" WHERE "HR_GANGLN"."GangCode" = ? ORDER BY "HR_EMPLOYEE"."EmpName"
